entries.summary: Host adapters can compute the instruction frozen by K8 sync with botTurnInstruction on the host-kit entry, using an options object and InstructionLimits.

Store lease and gate release failures preserve a refused ServiceInstallationError and its code, with the refusal and all release failures in its AggregateError cause; Hosts that matched the 0.42.0 AggregateError on first install must read cause instead. When a release fails and an upgrade, rollback or recover receipt remains pending, the new store_release_failed code directs the Host to recover; restart the Host process first if the stuck lease causes store_busy.

macOS Keychain and Linux Secret Service report an SDK entry that does not decode as the new KEYCHAIN_SECRET_CORRUPTED instead of KEYCHAIN_SECRET_DECODE_FAILED, and ProviderRegistry.replaceSecret/configure overwrite it with a new key. KEYCHAIN_SECRET_DECODE_FAILED now means an entry the SDK did not write; the registry never overwrites it and refuses before any write. A Host that offered 'enter the key again' for KEYCHAIN_SECRET_DECODE_FAILED offers it for KEYCHAIN_SECRET_CORRUPTED and shows delete, rename or other-profile guidance for KEYCHAIN_SECRET_DECODE_FAILED.

A path mutation gate release that fails while another error is thrown is kept: PathMutationGateBusyError, ServiceUnitError and LocalStateRelocation errors keep their class and code with an AggregateError of the original error and the release failures in cause, and an error of another class from a managed service lifecycle operation becomes that AggregateError. ServiceUnitError and the LocalStateRelocation error classes accept ErrorOptions. Hosts that read the original error of such a failure read it from cause.
